content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service "inference-runtime-prod" (INC-2026) — routed to escalation policy 'infra-platform-esc' which currently has DB oncall as primary. Auto-created incident thread. PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026

PagerDuty: A page has been sent to 3 responders. Incident key: INC-2026.

Alex: I just got the phone page — I'm on DB oncall, not inference. Did PD fire the wrong service?

Sana: same here, mobile vibration at 15:22 UTC. My schedule shows DB primary. Jordan should be inference primary this week.

Jordan: looking at PagerDuty config — service 'inference-runtime-prod' is pointing to escalation_policy 'infra-platform-esc' (id: PPLAT-999) instead of 'inference-runtime-esc' (id: PINF-123). That would route pages to infra/db team. Suspect recent infra config change.

Alex: oh yikes. Can someone ack to stop noisy paging and re-route to the correct policy? I'll ack until we confirm.

Ops Manager: Alex, please ack and add note "routing misconfigured". Jordan, take lead once reroute is done. If this is only routing (no customer-facing error), mark P2. If customers are affected, escalate to P1.

Jordan: Acking now and updating escalation policy. Steps I'm running:

```bash
# update service to correct escalation policy
curl -X PUT "https://api.pagerduty.com/services/PABC123" \
  -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "service": {
      "escalation_policy": {"id": "PINF-123", "type": "escalation_policy_reference"}
    }
  }'
```

Jordan: Done. PagerDuty returned 200. Re-sending page to inference oncall (Jordan).

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026 acknowledged by Jordan. Escalation policy changed to inference-runtime-esc (PINF-123). New notification sent to inference oncall.

Sana: Jordan — can you confirm whether the page was triggered by actual runtime errors or this was purely routing? I can run quick log checks.

Jordan: Running quick checks — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-runtime
Commands: `kubectl -n inference-prod logs -l app=inference-runtime --tail=200` and `kubectl -n inference-prod get pods -o wide`

Jordan: I see a brief spike of 502s starting 15:24 UTC, correlation with increased token queue depth. Not full outage, but SLO blip. Could be transient. Taking quick remediation: rolling restart of inference deployment to flush KV cache on GPU nodes.

Alex: tagging customer impact as "possible SLO blip" — recommend P2 until we see persistent errors.

Tess: after the immediate fix, we need a follow-up to: 1) correct PD service->escalation mapping permanently, 2) add a CI test that pages a test user through the expected escalation to detect miswires, and 3) document the recent infra change that caused the mapping swap. I'll open a ticket.

Jordan: Performing rolling restart: `kubectl -n inference-prod rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime` — pods restarting now. Monitoring metrics.

Jordan: Error rate dropped back to baseline within ~2 minutes after restart. Confirming logs show recovered KV hits and normal tail latency.

Ops Manager: Good. Action items:
- Alex: note in the incident that the immediate noise was caused by PD routing misconfiguration.
- Jordan: follow-up change to PD and verify escalation mapping.
- Tess: open INFRA-4321 to track permanent fix and CI test.

Alex: Added note in the incident: "Root cause (initial): PagerDuty service -> escalation policy mapping incorrectly updated to infra-platform-esc during recent infra config roll. Secondary: transient backend spike caused brief SLO blip." :white_check_mark:

Tess: INFRA-4321 created and assigned to me. Will include PD config diff and proposed CI test.

Ops Manager: Decide on postmortem: since customer-facing impact was < 5 minutes and already resolved, we'll keep this as an incident report + action items. Postmortem only if customers report or if we find recurring misrouting.

Jordan: Closing the PagerDuty incident as resolved. Confirmed PD change persists and test page went to correct oncall.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026 resolved by Jordan. Incident closed.

incident-bot: Note: please follow up with change request to PagerDuty mapping (ticket INFRA-4321), and add a scheduled test page to the oncall CI job.

Alex: Thanks all — please add the PD mapping check to the oncall runbook. :thumbsup:

Sana: quick note — looping in platform config owners to do a config audit this week.

Tess: Will schedule a short follow-up meeting to walk through the PD mapping and CI test design.

Ops Manager: Thanks team. Closing thread.
